title: Behavior key bindings
description: Layer 1 structural schema for a platform's key bindings, `behaviors/bindings/<platform>.json` (spec/behavior-contract.md, proposal 022 "Per-platform key bindings"). It maps a role and a key phase to existing event intents, so a contract names no key. Semantic rules (registered intents and capabilities) are Layer 2 (SPEC-124).

platform.description: Platform id (registry/platforms.json): the file name without `.json`.

capabilities.description: Capabilities (registry/capabilities.json) the platform has. A vector that needs another is not applicable on this platform.

roles.description: Per role (the `role` of a contract part, ARIA names), the bindings the platform has verified. A role absent here has no key binding on this platform.

key.description: Key names. Arrow keys are physical: right-to-left mirroring stays in the `navigate-*` intents, never in a binding.

intents.description: Event intent, or intents in order, the key raises in that phase.

keyboard.description: Key bindings. Other input kinds (touch, assistive) are added when a platform owner supplies verified entries.

suite.description: Key vectors for one platform and role (`conformance/behavior/bindings/<platform>/<role>.json`), run against every component whose role-carrying part has that role.
